enable_permission_bypass.title: Auto-approve Bulwark bundled-asset access
enable_permission_bypass.description: Skip permission prompts for Bulwark's own plugin scripts and bundled files (Read/Edit/Bash inside the plugin root). Writes and non-Bulwark paths are never auto-approved; path-traversal escapes are denied. Requires trusting Bulwark at install level. Default: off.
